{{Quote|The kolto refining platform that Colonel Korrd deployed is currently in disarray. The Empire barely maintains control of it. The number of soldiers capable of confronting our enemies dwindles by the day, and the Selkath push forward in their absence--with considerable Republic reinforcements.|Commander Qrukk|<ref name="TOR:VT">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Veiled Threats|Manaan}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Kolto Refining Platform''' was an industrial platform located at the surface of the aquqtic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The platform was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] to refine [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]]<ref name="TOR:RC" /> [[Imperial Kolto Mining Facility|mined]] from the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floor.<ref name="TOR:BP">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Borrowed Power|Manaan}}</ref> The Imperial Kolto Refining Platform saw intense fighting during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR:RC" /><ref name="TOR:SE">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Republic|Supplies Ending|Manaan}}</ref>
